title: Pandemic Flashback: April 10th, 2020
subtitle: A pandemic era podcast for a post pandemic world.
body_html: This episode of my podcast was never aired. It was recorded on April 10, 2020, and just never made it out the door. It holds up pretty well in retrospect. The pandemic changed so much, and it continues to change how we think, how we think, and how we love.
